newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Senate panel to vote on re-election bill.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Senate panel to vote on re-election bill.

text.p: A bill allowing Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso to run for re-election next year was due to be put to a vote in a committee in the Senate this morning, officials said.

The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee was due to vote on the constitutionality of an amendment allowing presidents, state governors and mayors to run for a second consecutive term of office.
If approved by the panel, the bill advances to the floor of the Senate where it requires two three-fifths majority votes.
The constitutional amendment has already been approved by the Chamber of Deputies.
